review_findings: The package verifier delegates every declaration to the existing Authoring and Composition parsers, so it cannot become a peer runtime.
Provider checks prove configuration coverage only and explicitly do not activate Providers or grant authority.
The full-development Workflow stops after CI evidence and does not include merge capability, preserving explicit merge authorization.
Installation is bounded to a verified declaration directory and refuses non-empty targets.
The change does not touch services, customer application source, runtime Dispatcher, Provider adapters, or TaskRun.

skill_rule_mappings.assessment: starter verification calls compile_workflow_declaration and compose_workflow; it never interprets graph execution
project provider coverage is checked against capability_registry while activation and Write Guard remain unchanged
customer-agent CI and full-development Workflows request PR creation and CI waiting but no merge capability
the package contains only Harness development declarations and does not write customer runtime source
